edits.new: The three states of the monitor are not the states of a version: a version is LOADED, APPROVED or RETIRED (AC1). The empty, loading, error and no access states of SCR-46 are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-2893); Screen Specifications v1 does not list them either.

disposition.note: Screen Specifications v1 lacks the four states, so they are marked Not specified rather than invented.
